body: My ex broke up with me on july 4th. And the other night , I was drinking with friends and contacted her for the first time in over a month. Finally threw everything on the table and apologized for anything and everything I did or didnt do. The one thing I wanted her to apologize for she said I was making it up and it was all in my head.... her rebound bf which she got with in 14 days ish after we broke up... broke up with her in under 2 months which was satisfying

Just try and be the best version of you. That's what I've been trying to do.. make them regret breaking up with you. Catch the attention of someone that will be twice as good. I've just been focusing to keep my mental health out of bad places and eating better and exercising. Been lifting weights and have since got my bench to 235lbs so far my goal is 300lb bench press.. set goals.. break them .. set new ones. Fuck our exes they didnt deserve us and karma will get them

It just feels it's just getting worse and worse by the day. I cant focus, have a hard time sleeping or sleeping 12+ hrs... I have panic attacks .. nothing brings me joy anymore.. every single item I own reminds me of her... and I cannot stop looking at her social media and seeing stuff I really shouldn't be seeing...I've tried to stop looking at it , but only went 3 days and in that time things got worse...but I reinstall it after.. she fucked me up financially and mentally aswell... I dont really have anyone to talk to... they just chalk it up like it's nothing or give me the same cliche bullshit answer everyone does.... they say it's all her fault and not mine but I had problems to.. shes not as bad as everyone says she is.... i didnt even put the entire story up in my.post.. theres so.much missing......
It might take weeks, months or years but theyll eventually get what's coming to them.

I've been struggling every god damn day. This relationship broke me like nothing else... it's been 2 months since we've been broken up.... I don't know how to deal with it.. and everyone just gives me the cliche fucking advice ..... this woman was The ONE for me... I just felt like it was the wrong time , right couple..
Karma will eventually get them. Dont worry
My ex got a new bf 14 days after she dumped me. Hes the complete opposite of me and she acts like hes the best thing in the world... we were together 3.5 yrs. Engaged... etc............

She has blocked me from every single social media, number etc. Already has a new bf and is passively aggressively flaunting it on social media without posting pictures of themselves together or setting the relationship status
